name: agentguard
description: Deprecated: agentguard is now okgate. Install okgate@agentwares for the same skills under /okgate:*; this plugin keeps them under /agentguard:* until at least 2027-01-15. Put okgate, an MCP policy proxy, in front of this project's MCP servers: a dry-run first, then spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, a kill switch and a hash-chained audit log. And check which rules in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md your coding agents broke, from your own sessions. Runs npx -p @agentwares/agentguard okgate on your machine; no account, no LLM calls.
